subject: bug in v2.6.1; I'm undoing the tag.

messages.author: cab04b8f0759c712
messages.subject: bug in v2.6.1; I'm undoing the tag.
parts:
Since we haven't announced it to the world, I'm going to assume we can undo the tag without harm.

The long long pull request has stopped some of our matrix operations from working.

Here is the pull request: https://github.com/stan-dev/stan/pull/1318

Here's the current bug: https://github.com/stan-dev/stan/issues/1337



Any objections to me removing the v2.6.1 tag and pretending it never existed? If so, I'll remove it. If not, we can not advertise v2.6.1 and release v2.6.2 asap.
